card.name: Word after modal verb phrase
card.fires_on: The word right after a modal phrase such as "can be", "should be", "may be", "should not, however," or "should". It is often "in", "prevent", "take", "true" or "at".

modes.label: After can/may/should be
modes.description: The word that follows a modal plus "be", such as "in" (inhaled, inactivated), "at", "true" or "the".
modes.example: The contents of each capsule can be<< in>>haled in 2 breaths.

modes.label: After should (not) verb
modes.description: A verb right after "should" or "should not, however,", such as "prevent" or "take".
modes.example: The potential for these risks should not, however,<< prevent>> the prescribing of hydromorphone

card.writes: The suppressed tokens are mostly Chinese words about handling or attitude, so this suggests no clear English output effect.
card.plain: It marks the word that comes straight after "can be", "should be" or "should not" in instructions and arguments.
